credits.title: The Bitch Pack
credits.overview: Luna, a misunderstood teenager, is accused of abuse by her own father and locked up in a juvenile detention center to await her final hearing. When her passion for urban music begins to catch the attention of her fellow inmates, she glimpses a different way to survive on the inside.

credits.title: ¡Soy un pelele!
credits.overview: Olvido, a low hours writer, sees a chance to regain his career and, above all, to win the love of his life, a renowned film director when he suffers a shock that leaves him amnesiac.
